base:
run:
  name: initial_sweep
  data: data.csv
preprocessing:
  drop_columns: [id]
  impute:
    age:
      method: fill_median
  encode:
    species:
      method: one_hot
sweep:
  projection:
    method: jl
    dimensions:
      values: [3, 5, 8]
    seed:
      values: [42, 7, 13]
    center: true
  pca:
    dimensions:
      values: [3, 5, 8]
    seed:
      values: [42, 7, 13]
  ball_mapper:
    epsilon:
      range:
        min: 0.5
        max: 2.0
        steps: 10
cosmic_graph:
  construction_threshold: auto
output:
  n_reps: 4
